basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast from Seattle, Washington. By day, I work as a software developer, specializing in game design. My evenings and weekends are often spent exploring the digital realms of SCP: Secret Laboratory and testing the limits of PCSX2. I love discussing the nuances of game mechanics and am a self-proclaimed aficionado of underappreciated gaming hardware. When I'm not gaming, you might find me planning my next travel adventure, with a particular interest in tropical destinations. Currently engaged and planning a honeymoon in Costa Rica, I often seek advice on travel forums. I usually browse Reddit late in the evenings after work or during weekends. Dislikes include misinformation and overly harsh online debates.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have spent the last 5 years working in the game development industry. My knowledge is mostly self-taught, supplemented by online courses and a lot of trial and error. I keep up with tech trends through subscriptions to gaming and tech forums.
